urdu transliteration: Karbal ki kahani jab koi bhi sunayega
english translation text: When anyone recounts the story of Karbala...
From dry and tearless eyes, tears shall begin to flow.

urdu transliteration:
1) HAR GHAM MILEGA TUMKO AAGHOSH NAINAWA
MEIN
KAISI KHIZA HAI CHAAI ZEHRA (A.S.) KE BAAGHBAAN
MEIN
QUR'AN KERBALA MEIN BIKHRAA NAZAR AAEGA
english translation text:
Every sorrow of Karbala will embrace you in Nainawa.
Such an autumn has fallen upon Zahra's garden.
The Qur'an itself appears scattered across Karbala.

urdu transliteration:
2) AKBAR (A.S.) SE NAWJAWAAN NE SINE PE BARCHI
KHAAKER
RUKH MORDIYA KAISE BABA KO MUNH DIKHAAKER KAISE ZA'EEF BABA BARCHI KO NIKAALEGA
english translation text:
After receiving the spear upon his chest, look at the young Akbar.
How did he turn back to face his father?
How will an aged father pull that spear from his son's body?

urdu transliteration:
3) ASGHER (A.S.) SE BE ZUBAANKI ZINDA DILI TO DEKHO
AALE NABI (S.A.W.W.) KE GHAR KA KAMSIN JARI TO DEKHO
PEHLE SHAHEED HOKER BABA KO BACHAAEGA
english translation text:
Behold the courage of speechless Asghar.
See the young warrior from the Household of the Prophet.
By becoming the first martyr, he will seek to save his father.

urdu transliteration:
4) DARYA THA SAAMNE PAR AALE NABI (S.A.W.W) THE PYAASE
BACHONKO BIBI ZAINAB (A.S.) DETI RAHI DILAASE LO JAARAHE HAI GHAAZI PAANI ABHI AAEGA
english translation text:
The river flowed nearby, yet the family of the Prophet remained thirsty.
Lady Zainab continued comforting the children, saying:
“Look, Abbas is going now—he will soon return with water.”

urdu transliteration:
5) KHAIME KE DAR PE DUKHYA ZAINAB (A.S.) YE
SOCHTI THI
GHAAZI KE JAATE HI WO CHAADER KO DEKHTI THI
MERI RIDA KA ZAAMIN KYA LOT KE AAEGA
english translation text:
At the entrance of the tent, grief-stricken Zainab stood thinking.
As soon as Ghazi departed, she looked towards her chador.
“Will the guardian of my veil ever return?”
